Minor presentation imperfections remain, such as some long tables and summary-node-time wording, but they do not impede reading."}],"requirements":[{"id":"R1","met":"yes","where":"1 Introduction"},{"id":"R2","met":"yes","where":"1 Introduction"},{"id":"R3","met":"yes","where":"1 Introduction"},{"id":"R4","met":"yes","where":"2.2 Launch"},{"id":"R5","met":"yes","where":"2.3 Orbit"},{"id":"R6","met":"yes","where":"2.3 Orbit"},{"id":"R7","met":"yes","where":"2.4 Ground Control & Communications"},{"id":"R8","met":"yes","where":"2.5 Mission Duration & EOL"},{"id":"R9","met":"yes","where":"2.3 Orbit and Appendix A"},{"id":"R10","met":"yes","where":"Appendix A: STK files and settings"},{"id":"R11","met":"yes","where":"Contents; Bibliography"}],"technical_issues":[{"where":"2.4 Ground Control & Communications","issue":"No full X-band link budget is calculated; 50 Mbit/s downlink and usable contact time are assumed, and Mount Pleasant must be fitted with S/X-band equipment."},{"where":"Executive Summary / 2.4","issue":"The quoted 9.7 min mean pass is horizon-to-horizon including low-elevation contact; usable contact is shorter, though the data budget later uses a discounted 34 min/day."},{"where":"2.2 Launch","issue":"Baseline depends on Vega C, which the report states has not yet flown; the Falcon 9 fallback is sensible, but a different rideshare altitude requires the SSO inclination and coverage analysis to be redone."}],"overall":"High-quality, well-supported design covering all required elements. Minor gaps are the uncalculated X-band link budget, assumed ground-station RF fit-out, and reliance on Vega C. The report is technically sound, well evidenced and clearly presented."}
